description: A guard clause is a chain of four `||` operands, but every test that enters it does so through `a`. Istanbul reports the binary-expr fully covered ([3,3,3,2] — every operand evaluated, none of them proven decisive), so the gap has to be found from the operand structure plus the arguments the tests pass. Dropping `|| Number.isNaN(b)` from the guard would keep all three tests green.
